يصطخم (form VIII)
# يَصْطَخِمُ (yaṣṭaḵimu) /jasˤ.tˤa.xi.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# يَصْطَخِمَ (yaṣṭaḵima) /jasˤ.tˤa.xi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# يَصْطَخِمْ (yaṣṭaḵim) /jasˤ.tˤa.xim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
